verdict.rationale: Jules can be assigned tasks (via GitHub issues/labels) to autonomously edit code, run in a VM, and open PRs, and it does auto-detect an AGENTS.md file, which loosely touches 'agent-readiness' but there's no dedicated feature for detecting or fixing specific readiness/quality-gate criteria as a systematic check. Community reports are mixed, with several noting it struggles on complex/monorepo codebases and needs heavy babysitting, undermining reliability for automated gate-fixing.
